title: glTF Vertex Skinning in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu
description: Animate a glTF character with GPU vertex skinning in Rust, wgpu, and WGSL. Load joints, weights, inverse bind matrices, animation channels, and textures.
imageAlt: Slender purple, red, and gold Jax character walking on a black WebGPU canvas with GPU and FPS text.
